item.title: Ticktum describes rivals as ‘a*** lickers’ in social media rant over deleted comment | Formula 1
item.description: Dan Ticktum called his critics "losers" and said his rivals "want to lick Autosport's a*** because they want good media."

item.title: Doohan exits Alpine eight months after being dropped from race team | Formula 1
item.description: Alpine has formally parted ways with Jack Doohan, having dropped him from its race team roster last year after just seven appearances.

item.title: Cadillac reveal ‘Barcelona shakedown livery’ for new team’s first F1 test | Formula 1
item.description: Cadillac has revealed the livery its first Formula 1 car will run in when it makes its debut in pre-season testing later this month.

item.title: Round-up: Bianchi’s family says his stolen kart has been recovered, and more | RaceFans Round-up
item.description: Also in Wednesday's edition of the RaceFans round-up, ex-Formula 1 driver Antonio Pizzonia was arrested and later released in Texas.

item.title: Ferrari’s F1 livery is ‘not good design’, says Audi’s new title sponsor | Formula 1
item.description: Antoine Le Nel, chief marketing officer of Audi sponsor Revolut, dislikes Ferrari's HP's branding: "How can you put blue on a red car?"

item.title: Verstappen says he would “certainly not” have obeyed orders McLaren gave Piastri | Formula 1
item.description: Oscar Piastri should not have obeyed McLaren's order to let his team mate pass him while he was "in the middle of the title fight", says Max Verstappen.

item.title: Masi ‘basically gifted the championship’ to Verstappen says 2021 FIA steward Sullivan | Formula 1
item.description: A Formula 1 driver steward who worked during the 2021 season says former race director Michael Masi "gifted" that year's world championship to Max Verstappen.

item.description: The bright blue colouring of Ford will feature more prominently on both of Red Bull's Formula 1 teams in 2026.
